E-Books

Six open textbooks on R, data wrangling, ggplot2, base R visualization, SQL and Bash. Read free online, or download the PDF and ePub of each.

Six open textbooks, free to read online. Written with bookdown and hosted on Rsquared Academy. Every title can also be downloaded as a PDF or ePub.

Learning path

The Core Track is designed to be followed end to end. The two companions slot in alongside it rather than after it.

Core 01

Intro to R

BeginnerZero to running code. RStudio, packages, help.

Core 02

Data Wrangling

BeginnerImport, reshape, dplyr, pipes, tibbles.

Core 03

Viz with ggplot2

IntermediateGrammar of graphics through to publication polish.

Core 04

R, Databases & SQL

IntermediateDBI, dbplyr, queries, joins.

Shortcut: already wrangling data in SQL? Take 04 straight after 02.

Companion A — Foundational Tooling

Command Line Basics

BeginnerFiles, permissions, pipes and scripting for R users. Pair with Core 01.

On Windows: everything works from the RStudio Terminal, Git Bash or WSL — chapter 1 covers all three.

Companion B — Graphics Deep-Dive

Data Viz with Base R

IntermediateBase graphics engine, parameters, multi-panel layouts, production export. Zero dependencies. After Core 03.

Series at a glance

Six titles in the order they are meant to be read.

01 Intro - Introduction to R

02 Wrangle - Data Wrangling with R

03 ggplot2 - Data Visualization with ggplot2

04 SQL - R, Databases and SQL

C-A Bash - Command Line Basics

C-B Base - Data Visualization with Base R

If you are starting from zero, begin with Introduction to R. The full catalogue, with download links for every title, is also at ebooks.rsquaredacademy.com.
